name: Discount Rules and Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce
author: AsanaPlugins

sections.description:
Discount Rules and Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce (formerly Easy WooCommerce Discounts) is the most complete free WooCommerce discount plugin and dynamic pricing tool. Create bulk discounts, quantity discounts, BOGO deals (buy one get one free), category discounts, storewide percentage discounts, cart-total offers, and auto-apply coupons — all without writing a single line of code. It’s a proven sales strategy for increasing average order value, reducing cart abandonment, and driving ecommerce conversions without manually re-pricing a single product.

Whether you need a buy 2 get 1 free or buy 3 get 1 free deal, a WooCommerce dynamic pricing rule, a scheduled flash sale, a cart total discount, a category-wide sale, or a WooCommerce coupon that applies automatically — the free version handles every core scenario from a single admin panel, for simple and variable products.

Need advanced features like wholesale pricing, user role-based pricing, conditional pricing, tiered pricing, live price display, purchase history rules, checkout fees, or product bundle discounts? Those are available in the PRO version.

LIVE DEMO (Front-End) | LIVE DEMO (Back-End) | Ask a Question | Documentation | Video Playlist | GET PRO — UP TO 75% OFF

✅ Free Version Features

Product Discounts

  • Bulk / Quantity Discount — volume discounts by quantity tier
  • Category Coupon and Category Discount — % or fixed off entire categories
  • Percentage Discounts — storewide or per-product
  • Storewide and scheduled discounts
  • BOGO — Buy One Get One Free — Buy 1/2/3 Get 1, Buy X Get Y, and more
  • Exclude products from any rule

Cart & Order Discounts

  • Cart Discount Rules — e.g. 20% off sitewide on Black Friday
  • Cart/order total discounts — e.g. spend $100, get 15% off
  • Auto-apply and manual coupons — no code entry needed, or activate with a specific code

Display & Notifications

  • Quantity / bulk pricing table — shown automatically on the product page, or anywhere via [wccs_bulk_table]
  • Product page messages — inform customers of active rules before they add to cart
  • “You Saved” display — total savings shown in cart and at checkout
  • Rules analytics — track rule impressions and performance in the dashboard
  • Discount templates — pre-built rule templates to launch your first discount in minutes

Shipping

  • Free shipping by cart total, weight-based and scheduled methods
  • Shipping method rules — show/hide by cart total, weight, item count, or date

BUY PRO UP TO 75% OFF →

📦 WooCommerce Bulk Discount & Quantity Discount

A WooCommerce bulk discount (or quantity discount) automatically lowers the per-unit price as customers buy more — a proven way to increase average order value and clear inventory faster. Also called tiered pricing. Basic bulk pricing tiers are free and unlimited; advanced per-tier percentages and role-based tiers are in PRO.

  • Buy 1–5 units → 0% off (regular price)
  • Buy 6–10 units → 10% off
  • Buy 11–20 units → 20% off
  • Buy 21+ units → 30% off

Volume kick discounts: reward the entire order once a quantity threshold is hit — e.g. buy 10+, and all 10 units get 20% off retroactively, not just the units past the 10th. A distinct alternative to standard tiered pricing when you want an all-or-nothing volume incentive.

The redesigned quantity pricing table — with pre-built themes and a live settings preview — displays automatically on the product page, or anywhere via [wccs_bulk_table].

📖 Tutorial | 🎥 Video

🏷️ WooCommerce Category Discount

A WooCommerce category discount applies a percentage or fixed discount to an entire product category in one step — no editing individual products. Combine with date ranges or a minimum cart total, apply to multiple categories at once, and exclude specific products. Ideal for seasonal sales and clearance events.

  • Set a percentage discount on any category (e.g. 20% off all “Winter Jackets”)
  • Set a fixed amount discount on any category (e.g. $10 off all “Accessories”)

📖 Tutorial | 🎥 Video

🛒 WooCommerce BOGO Deals — Buy One Get One Free

BOGO deals are one of the highest-converting promotions in e-commerce, and every common variation is free for simple and variable products. The free item adds to cart automatically, no manual step needed. Category-based and variation-based BOGO rules are in PRO.

  • Buy 1 Get 1 Free — Classic buy one get one free
  • Buy 2 Get 1 Free — Buy two, get the third at no cost
  • Buy 3 Get 1 Free — Perfect for multi-pack promotions
  • Buy X Get Y — Buy product A and receive product B free or at a discount
  • Buy One Get One 50% Off — Buy one item, get the second at half price
  • Buy 2X Get 1Y Free — cross-product reward, e.g. buy 2 shampoos, get 1 conditioner free
  • Buy 3, Cheapest Free — automatically discounts the lowest-priced item in the cart

BOGO use cases:

  • Cosmetics and personal care — buy one shampoo, get conditioner free
  • Food and grocery — buy 3, pay for 2 multi-pack deals
  • Apparel — buy two shirts, get one free to clear end-of-season stock
  • SaaS or digital products — buy one license, get a second at no charge

📖 Tutorial | 🎥 Video

💲 WooCommerce Dynamic Pricing

WooCommerce dynamic pricing changes prices and discounts automatically based on conditions you set — no manual editing, no coupon codes. Free: quantity-based, cart-total, date-based, and category-based dynamic pricing. PRO adds live price display, role-based (wholesale/VIP) conditional pricing, purchase-history pricing, and advanced tiered pricing rules.

  • Quantity-based dynamic pricing (more items = lower price per unit)
  • Cart-total dynamic pricing (spend $X, get Y% off)
  • Date-based dynamic pricing (flash sales and scheduled promotions)
  • Category-based dynamic pricing (automatic discounts on entire product categories)

📖 Tutorial | 🎥 Video

📊 WooCommerce Tiered Pricing (PRO)

Tiered pricing — also called volume pricing or volume discounts — gives progressively larger discounts as customers buy more. Basic quantity tiers are free; advanced per-tier percentages, role-based tiers, and attribute conditions are in PRO: e.g. 5% off at 5 units, 12% off at 10, 20%+5% wholesale off at 20+.

PRO tiered pricing example:

  • Quantity 1–4: regular price
  • Quantity 5–9: 5% off
  • Quantity 10–19: 12% off
  • Quantity 20+: 20% off — plus an additional 5% off for wholesale user role

📖 Tutorial

🔖 WooCommerce Scheduled Discounts & Flash Sales

Free version: schedule any rule with a start/end date, run it on specific days, or repeat it weekly — perfect for flash sales, Black Friday, and holiday promotions. PRO adds a countdown timer on product pages to drive urgency.

📖 Tutorial

🎫 WooCommerce Coupon & Auto-Apply Coupon

Turn discount rules into auto-applied WooCommerce coupons — no code entry, less cart abandonment.

  • Auto-apply coupons — applied automatically at checkout when conditions are met
  • Manual coupons — activate a rule only when a specific code is entered
  • Cart/order total coupons — e.g. apply a coupon when a customer spends over $100
  • Scheduled coupons — activate and deactivate automatically on set dates
  • PRO: smart coupons, shareable URL coupons (auto-apply + optionally add products to cart), and user role coupon templates

📖 Tutorial | 🎥 Video

💳 WooCommerce Checkout Fee (PRO)

Add conditional surcharges at checkout — a PRO feature. Base fees on payment method, shipping postcode, cart weight, or specific products. Use a negative value to give a checkout discount instead.

📖 Tutorial

🚚 WooCommerce Shipping Rules

Free: free shipping by cart total, weight-based methods, scheduled shipping, and rules to show/hide shipping methods. PRO unlocks the full condition library (shipping zone, customer role, purchase history, and more) plus the Shipping Discount addon for percentage/fixed discounts on any shipping method.

📖 Tutorial | 🎥 Video

⭐ PRO Version Features

BUY PRO UP TO 75% OFF →

PRO unlocks every advanced conditional pricing scenario:

  • Live price display — real-time updates as quantity changes
  • Advanced tiered & role-based pricing — wholesale, VIP, purchase-history conditions
  • Advanced BOGO — Buy X Get X, category & variation-based, 🎁 gift emoji on free items
  • Auto Add Products to Cart addon — free gift at a spending threshold
  • Bundle & Mix and Match discounts — fixed bundle pricing, or “Any 3 for $60” style mix-and-match deals from a product pool
  • Variation & attribute discounts
  • First order & sign-up discounts — reward new customers automatically
  • Recurring discounts for WooCommerce Subscriptions
  • Checkout fees & payment method discounts
  • Smart coupons & URL coupons — share a link that auto-applies a coupon
  • WooCommerce Countdown Timer on product pages
  • Usage restrictions — limit how often a rule can fire, per store or per user
  • Shipping Discount addon — % or fixed discounts on any shipping method

Every PRO rule can combine any condition from our full library: customer role & purchase history, cart contents & totals, shipping zone, payment method, product categories/attributes/tags, and more. See the full condition list →

📚 Tutorials & Video Tutorials

Every feature above links directly to its own step-by-step guide and video. For the complete library, visit All Tutorials or our YouTube Playlist.

🎉 Our Other Plugins

  • Product Bundles — Free | Pro
  • Product Badge, Label & Countdown Timer — Free | Pro
  • SideCart & Upsell — Free | Pro
  • AI Content Writing & WhatsApp Chat — Free | Pro
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Discount Rules and Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Woo Pricing & Discounts menu to create your first discount rule.

Or upload manually:

  1. Upload the easy-woocommerce-discounts folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate through Plugins in the WordPress admin.
  3. Visit the Documentation for detailed setup instructions.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 4.4.1 or greater
  • WooCommerce 3.0.0 or greater
  • PHP 5.6.0 or greater
  • MySQL 5.0 or greater
sections.faq:
How do I create a bulk discount in WooCommerce?

Install the plugin, go to Woo Pricing & Discounts → Pricing tab → Add from Template, and select the Bulk Savings: Buy More, Save % template. Set your quantity ranges and discount amounts (percentage or fixed). The bulk pricing table will appear automatically on the product page. You can also use the [wccs_bulk_table] shortcode to display it anywhere. Available in the free version. Full tutorial: WooCommerce Bulk Discounts.

How do I create a BOGO (buy one get one free) deal in WooCommerce?

Go to Woo Pricing & Discounts → Pricing tab → Add from Template and select one of the “BOGO: Buy 1 Get 1 Free” or “Free Gift: Buy X, Get Y for Free” templates. Select your buy and get products. The free product is added to the cart automatically. Buy 1 Get 1, Buy 2 Get 1, Buy 3 Get 1, and Buy X Get Y are all available in the free version. Full tutorial: BOGO Deals in WooCommerce.

How do I create a buy 2 get 1 free deal in WooCommerce?

Go to Woo Pricing & Discounts → Pricing tab → Add from Template and select the “Buy 2 Get 1 Free (Same Item)” or “Combo Pack: Buy 2 of X, Get 1 Y Free” template. Select your buy and get products. The free item is added to the cart automatically. Available in the free version. Full tutorial: Buy 2 Get 1 Free in WooCommerce.

How do I create a category discount in WooCommerce?

Go to Woo Pricing & Discounts → Pricing tab → Add from Template and select the “Category Discovery” template. Choose Percentage or Price for the Adjustment Type, then under Discounted Products select Categories. The discount applies to all products in those categories automatically. Available in the free version. Full tutorial: WooCommerce Category Discounts.

How do I create a tiered pricing rule in WooCommerce?

Basic quantity-based tiered discounts (buy more, save more) are available in the free version — go to Woo Pricing & Discounts → Pricing tab → Add from Template and select the Bulk Savings: Buy More, Save % template. Add multiple quantity ranges with different discount percentages. Advanced tiered pricing with role-based conditions, attribute targeting, and live price display is available in the PRO version. Full tutorial: Tiered Discounts in WooCommerce.

What is the difference between bulk discount and tiered pricing?

They refer to the same concept. “Bulk discount” and “quantity discount” mean giving a lower price when customers buy more items. “Tiered pricing” and “volume pricing” describe the same strategy with multiple price levels at different quantity thresholds. Basic bulk/quantity discounts are available in the free version. Advanced tiered pricing rules with additional conditions are available in PRO.

What is a volume kick discount?

Unlike standard tiered pricing, where only the units past a threshold get the lower price, a volume kick discount applies the discount retroactively to every unit once the threshold is met — e.g. buy 10+, and all 10 units get 20% off, not just units 10 and up. Available in the free version.

How do I set up a WooCommerce coupon that applies automatically?

Create a Cart Discount rule and set your conditions (date, cart total, products, etc.). When a customer meets those conditions, the WooCommerce coupon discount is applied at checkout automatically — no code needed. You can also create manual coupons that require a specific code. Both modes are available in the free version.

How do I create a discount or auto-apply coupon based on cart total?

Go to Woo Pricing & Discounts → Discounts tab → Add from Template and select the Minimum Spend template. Set the cart total threshold and discount amount — for example, spend over $100, get 15% off. Available in the free version.

How do I create a WooCommerce checkout fee?

WooCommerce checkout fees are available in the PRO version. Go to Woo Pricing & Discounts → Fees tab to create a checkout fee rule. You can base fees on payment method, cart weight, shipping postcode, or specific products in the cart. Full tutorial: Create Payment Gateway Fees in WooCommerce.

Can I add a surcharge for a specific payment method in WooCommerce?

Yes, this is a PRO version feature. Create a Checkout Fee rule and add a Payment Method condition — for example, add a 2% surcharge for credit card payments. Full tutorial: Payment Method Fee in WooCommerce.

Can I offer wholesale pricing or different prices per user role?

This is a PRO version feature. With PRO, create a pricing rule and add a User Role condition. For example, wholesale customers get 25% off all products automatically when they log in. Full tutorial: User Role Based Pricing for WooCommerce.

Can I create a flash sale or scheduled discount?

Yes, available in the free version. Every rule has a Date Range option (From Date / To Date). Set the start and end date and the rule activates and deactivates automatically. You can also target specific days of the week. The PRO version adds a Countdown Timer on product pages. Full tutorial: WooCommerce Flash Sale.

Does this plugin show a quantity pricing table on the product page?

Yes, available in the free version. When you create a bulk pricing rule, a quantity table appears on the product page automatically. Customize its position and style in the plugin settings. Use [wccs_bulk_table] shortcode to place it anywhere.

Can I offer a discount based on purchase history?

This is a PRO version feature. Add a Purchase History condition to any rule — for example, customers who spent $200+ in previous orders get 10% off their next order.

Does this plugin support variable products and product variations?

The free version supports discount rules on variable products as a whole. Targeting individual product variations specifically (e.g. only Size: XL of a shirt) is a PRO version feature.

Can I give a discount on a customer’s first order?

This is a PRO version feature. Go to Woo Pricing & Discounts → Discounts tab → Add from Template and select the “New Customer Welcome” or “Welcome Gift” template. Full tutorial: First Order Discount in WooCommerce.

How do I create a storewide discount in WooCommerce?

Go to Woo Pricing & Discounts → Pricing tab → Add from Template, select the Storewide template, and set your discount type and amount. Available in the free version. Add date conditions to make it a scheduled storewide sale. Full tutorial: WooCommerce Apply Discount to All Products.

Is it possible to exclude products from a discount rule?

Yes, available in the free version. Every rule has an Excluded Products section where you can select individual products or categories to exclude — for example, exclude already on-sale products from a storewide discount.

Can I create “Mix and Match” or “Any 3 for $X” style deals?

Yes, this is a PRO version feature. Define a pool of eligible products and a bundle price or discount — for example, “Any 3 items from this category for $60.” Customers can mix any combination from the pool and the price adjusts automatically in the cart. tutorial: Create Mix & Match Product Discounts

Can I offer free shipping as a discount?

Yes, available in the free version. Create a shipping rule with a cart total condition (e.g. free shipping over $50). PRO adds advanced conditions plus a Shipping Discount addon for percentage/fixed discounts on existing methods. Full tutorial: WooCommerce Free Shipping Based on Cart Subtotal.

Can I automatically add a free gift product to the cart?

The Auto Add Products to Cart feature is available as an addon for the PRO version. When a customer reaches a spending threshold, a free gift product is automatically added to their cart. Full tutorial: Auto Add Products to Cart in WooCommerce.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Yes. The plugin includes compatibility with WooCommerce Subscriptions, including recurring discount types.

How many discount rules can I create, and can several run at once?

Unlimited rules in both free and PRO, and yes, multiple rules can run simultaneously — they’re applied by priority, so you control which one takes precedence when more than one matches the same product or cart.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce Blocks (cart and checkout blocks)?

Yes. The plugin includes compatibility with the WooCommerce cart block and checkout block.

Is this plugin compatible with WPML and multilingual setups?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WPML for multilingual WooCommerce stores.

Can I create a discount based on shipping country or city?

This is a PRO version feature. Add a Shipping Country, Shipping State, or Shipping City condition to any rule. For example: customers shipping to Texas get 15% off.

Does the plugin display how much a customer has saved?

Yes, available in the free version. The “You Saved” total is displayed in the cart and at checkout so customers clearly see the value of their discount.

Can I use this plugin without coupon codes?

Yes. Pricing rules and cart discount rules apply automatically when customers meet the conditions — no coupon code required.
